name: proseshape
description: Rewrite or write prose so it reads as chosen by a person, not defaulted by a model, while keeping every fact, quotation, plot event, and the writer's voice.

interface.longDescription: ProseShape rewrites or writes prose so each choice reads as made by a person for this reader, not inherited from a model's defaults. It keeps every fact, number, quotation, citation, plot event, and the writer's voice. It removes sentence-level habits (staged contrasts, one-line closers, inflated significance, chatbot residue) and story-level defaults (stated morals, tidy single-track plots, emotions told through the body, epiphany and epilogue endings). It does light edits, ordinary rewrites, fiction restructuring when you allow it, voice matching from a sample, and writing from scratch. It is built for readers, not AI detectors. It is instructions only: it runs no code and sends nothing anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Use ProseShape to humanize this draft. Keep every fact and the ending.
Use ProseShape for a light polish only; keep every citation exactly as is.
Use ProseShape to rewrite this so it sounds like the two samples I wrote.
